rationale: Roberts is likely to keep the Court on a narrow stare-decisis/administrability holding reaffirming Wong Kim Ark’s territorial-jurisdiction rule and rejecting an unlawful-presence carveout, making him the modal assignee and author. Thomas is very likely to write alone in dissent on original meaning and “complete political jurisdiction,” while a few in the majority may add short concurrences to emphasize originalist/textual support (Gorsuch/Barrett) or reliance/fairness concerns (Kavanaugh/Jackson).
